title: CareerOS Job
description: A schema for representing a job opportunity or role within CareerOS.

id.description: A stable identifier for the job.

company.description: The company associated with the job opportunity.

title.description: The title of the job opportunity.

summary.description: A concise summary of the role and its purpose.

responsibilities.description: The responsibilities expected of the role.

requirements.description: The mandatory requirements for the role.

preferredQualifications.description: Preferred qualifications or differentiators for the role.

technologies.description: Technologies, toolchains, or platforms associated with the role.

salary.description: The salary or compensation range offered for the role.

workMode.description: The working arrangement for the role.

employmentType.description: The employment arrangement for the role.

location.description: The primary location for the role.

metadata.description: Lifecycle and governance metadata for the job record.
